items.q: In y = mx + c, what is c?
items.correct: The y-intercept (where the line crosses the y-axis).
items.why: m is the gradient; c is the y-intercept.

items.q: How does a steeper line's gradient compare?
items.random_wrong: All lines have the same gradient.
items.why: Gradient = rise ÷ run; steeper lines have larger gradients.
